performance.verdict: Meta driving all leads; Google's $2,120 yielded zero trackable signed cases.

findings.text: 5 overdue SOW milestones (due Jul 31–Aug 1): Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site/Landing Pages, Ads Launch, and Meta Retargeting — none confirmed complete as of Sep 14.
Meta CPL is efficient: 18 leads on $740.67 (28d) vs Google's $2,120.45 yielding only 7 unverified conversions — Google cost-per-result is ~$303 vs Meta's ~$41.
3-day lead signal (Sep 11–13: 6 leads, avg $170/day spend) vs prior 3 days (Sep 8–10: 7 leads, avg $156/day) — volume holding but Google spend days remain erratic with multiple $0 gaps.
GHL shows 72 opportunities created against only 18 in-platform leads — a 54-opp gap with 0 appointments and 0 won deals suggests intake or attribution leak, not an ads problem.
GBP actions dropped 58% week-over-week (to near-zero last 2 days) while paid spend held — organic visibility declining independently of ads.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 5 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer immediately; LSA gap alone costs ~$303/lead vs Meta's $41.
suggestions.monday_update: Five SOW milestones due Jul 31–Aug 1 show no completion event: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site/Landing Pages, Ads Launch, and Meta Retargeting. Google is spending $2,120.45 for 7 unverified conversions (~$303 each) while Meta delivers leads at ~$41 — the gap is partly attributable to LSA not being live. Nacer to confirm completion status on all five by Sep 17. Success = all five marked complete or a written remediation timeline in place.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL intake: 72 opportunities vs 18 tracked leads — reconcile the 54-opp gap and confirm 0 appointments is a data error or real.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL reports 72 opportunities created but only 18 leads tracked in-platform, and 0 appointments booked in the 28-day window. This 54-opp discrepancy and 0 won deals means we cannot confirm any lead converted to a signed case — the firm's core KPI. Sohib to pull a GHL pipeline audit and confirm whether duplicate contacts, manual entries, or a pipeline misconfiguration are inflating the opp count. Resolution target: Sep 18. Success = opp count reconciled and at least one stage-to-signed-case path confirmed.

suggestions.text: Watch Google erratic spend days ($0 on 8+ days in 45-day series) — confirm campaign continuity before any budget shift.
suggestions.monday_update: Google spend shows at least 8 zero-spend days in the last 45-day series, with $2,120.45 concentrated in burst days — this pattern suggests campaign pausing, budget exhaustion, or eligibility issues rather than steady delivery. No budget shift to or from Google is defensible until spend continuity is confirmed. Re-check Sep 17 to see if the last 3 days (Sep 14–16) hold steady daily delivery above $100. Success = 3 consecutive spend days with no $0 gaps.
